children.expr: (List.range l.length).map (fun i : Nat => l.getD (Int.toNat ((Int.ofNat i - Int.ofNat n + Int.ofNat l.length) % Int.ofNat l.length)) (l.headD 0))

lemmas.name: rotate_ok
lemmas.statement: ∀ (l : List Int) (n : Nat) (h : rotateRight_precond l n), l.length ≠ 0 → rotateRight_postcond l n ((List.range l.length).map (fun i : Nat => l.getD (Int.toNat ((Int.ofNat i - Int.ofNat n + Int.ofNat l.length) % Int.ofNat l.length)) (l.headD 0))) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro l n h hne
  unfold rotateRight_postcond
  refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  have hidx : Int.toNat ((Int.ofNat i - Int.ofNat n + Int.ofNat l.length) % Int.ofNat l.length) < l.length := by
    simp only [Int.ofNat_eq_natCast]
    have h1 := Int.emod_lt_of_pos ((i : Int) - (n : Int) + (l.length : Int)) (by omega : (0:Int) < (l.length : Int))
    have h0 := Int.emod_nonneg ((i : Int) - (n : Int) + (l.length : Int)) (by omega : (l.length : Int) ≠ 0)
    omega
  simp only [List.getElem?_map, List.getElem?_range hi, Option.map_some]
  rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hidx, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx]
